discovery: Cosmic inflation and the quantum-mechanical origin of cosmic structure
motivation: Guth proposed inflation as an accelerated expansion of the very early universe that explains its flatness, homogeneity and the absence of relics. Linde turned the idea into a working theory with new and chaotic inflation. Mukhanov calculated that quantum vacuum fluctuations, stretched by inflation, seed all cosmic structure. His calculation predicts adiabatic, nearly Gaussian perturbations with a power spectrum that is nearly scale-invariant but slightly red-tilted. These were falsifiable predictions made decades in advance. Over three decades, COBE, WMAP, Planck and ground-based CMB experiments confirmed them with increasing precision: the universe is spatially flat, there are coherent super-horizon acoustic peaks, and the spectral index n_s ≈ 0.965 is measured to differ from exact scale invariance at more than 8σ. Inflation made the first moments of the universe an empirical science and links quantum field theory directly to the largest structures we observe.
